USE [thienhaso_WEB_His_TimTamDuc_2025]

/*
    Ban Lanh Dao Full Page CMS
    - Reuses CMS_LandingPage as the page registry.
    - Stores immutable VI/EN snapshots in CMS_BanLanhDaoPageVersion.
    - The public site reads only the published snapshot.
*/

IF COL_LENGTH('dbo.CMS_LandingPage', 'PageName') IS NULL
    ALTER TABLE dbo.CMS_LandingPage ADD PageName NVARCHAR(200) NULL
GO

IF COL_LENGTH('dbo.CMS_LandingPage', 'MetaDescription') IS NULL
    ALTER TABLE dbo.CMS_LandingPage ADD MetaDescription NVARCHAR(1000) NULL
GO

IF COL_LENGTH('dbo.CMS_LandingPage', 'ProjectJson') IS NULL
    ALTER TABLE dbo.CMS_LandingPage ADD ProjectJson NVARCHAR(MAX) NULL
GO

IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.CMS_BanLanhDaoPageVersion', N'U') IS NULL
BEGIN
    CREATE TABLE dbo.CMS_BanLanhDaoPageVersion
    (
        BanLanhDaoPageVersionID BIGINT IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL,
        LandingPageID INT NOT NULL,
        VersionNo INT NOT NULL,
        HtmlBodyVi NVARCHAR(MAX) NOT NULL,
        HtmlBodyEn NVARCHAR(MAX) NULL,
        CssText NVARCHAR(MAX) NULL,
        ProjectJsonVi NVARCHAR(MAX) NULL,
        ProjectJsonEn NVARCHAR(MAX) NULL,
        IsPublished BIT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_CMS_BanLanhDaoPageVersion_IsPublished DEFAULT(0),
        CreatedDate DATETIME NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_CMS_BanLanhDaoPageVersion_CreatedDate DEFAULT(GETDATE()),
        CreatedUser NVARCHAR(100) NULL,
        PublishedDate DATETIME NULL,
        PublishedUser NVARCHAR(100) NULL,
        CONSTRAINT PK_CMS_BanLanhDaoPageVersion PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED (BanLanhDaoPageVersionID),
        CONSTRAINT FK_CMS_BanLanhDaoPageVersion_LandingPage
            FOREIGN KEY (LandingPageID) REFERENCES dbo.CMS_LandingPage(LandingPageID)
    )

    CREATE UNIQUE INDEX UX_CMS_BanLanhDaoPageVersion_PageVersion
        ON dbo.CMS_BanLanhDaoPageVersion(LandingPageID, VersionNo)

    CREATE INDEX IX_CMS_BanLanhDaoPageVersion_Published
        ON dbo.CMS_BanLanhDaoPageVersion(LandingPageID, IsPublished, BanLanhDaoPageVersionID)
END
GO

IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.CMS_LandingPage WHERE PageName = N'BAN_LANH_DAO')
BEGIN
    INSERT INTO dbo.CMS_LandingPage
    (
        Slug, Title, Description, Keyword, CssText, HtmlBody,
        IsActive, SortOrder, CreatedDate, CreatedUser,
        ProjectJson, PageName, MetaDescription
    )
    VALUES
    (
        N'ban-lanh-dao', N'Ban Lãnh Đạo | Bệnh viện Tim Tâm Đức', N'Ban Lanh Dao system page', N'ban-lanh-dao',
        NULL, NULL, 0, 0, GETDATE(), N'seed', NULL, N'BAN_LANH_DAO',
        N'Ban Giám đốc và Hội đồng Quản trị nhiệm kỳ VII 2024–2028 của Bệnh viện Tim Tâm Đức.'
    )
END
GO

IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.CMS_BanLanhDaoPage_GetCMS', N'P') IS NOT NULL
    DROP PROCEDURE dbo.CMS_BanLanhDaoPage_GetCMS
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.CMS_BanLanhDaoPage_GetCMS
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON

    DECLARE @LandingPageID INT
    Select Top 1 @LandingPageID = LandingPageID
    From dbo.CMS_LandingPage
    Where PageName = N'BAN_LANH_DAO'
    Order By LandingPageID

    Select Top 1
        P.LandingPageID,
        P.PageName,
        P.Slug,
        P.Title,
        P.MetaDescription,
        V.BanLanhDaoPageVersionID,
        V.VersionNo,
        V.HtmlBodyVi,
        V.HtmlBodyEn,
        V.CssText,
        V.ProjectJsonVi,
        V.ProjectJsonEn,
        V.IsPublished,
        V.CreatedDate,
        V.CreatedUser,
        V.PublishedDate,
        V.PublishedUser
    From dbo.CMS_LandingPage P
    Left Join dbo.CMS_BanLanhDaoPageVersion V
        On V.LandingPageID = P.LandingPageID
    Where P.LandingPageID = @LandingPageID
    Order By V.BanLanhDaoPageVersionID Desc
END
GO

IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.CMS_BanLanhDaoPage_GetPublished', N'P') IS NOT NULL
    DROP PROCEDURE dbo.CMS_BanLanhDaoPage_GetPublished
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.CMS_BanLanhDaoPage_GetPublished
    @LanguageID INT = 1
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON

    Select Top 1
        P.LandingPageID,
        P.PageName,
        P.Slug,
        P.Title,
        P.MetaDescription,
        V.BanLanhDaoPageVersionID,
        V.VersionNo,
        Case When @LanguageID = 2 And NULLIF(V.HtmlBodyEn, N'') Is Not Null
             Then V.HtmlBodyEn Else V.HtmlBodyVi End As HtmlBody,
        V.CssText,
        V.IsPublished,
        V.PublishedDate,
        V.PublishedUser
    From dbo.CMS_LandingPage P
    Inner Join dbo.CMS_BanLanhDaoPageVersion V
        On V.LandingPageID = P.LandingPageID
       And V.IsPublished = 1
    Where P.PageName = N'BAN_LANH_DAO'
      And P.IsActive = 1
    Order By V.BanLanhDaoPageVersionID Desc
END
GO

IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.CMS_BanLanhDaoPage_GetVersion', N'P') IS NOT NULL
    DROP PROCEDURE dbo.CMS_BanLanhDaoPage_GetVersion
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.CMS_BanLanhDaoPage_GetVersion
    @BanLanhDaoPageVersionID BIGINT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON

    Select
        P.LandingPageID,
        P.PageName,
        P.Slug,
        P.Title,
        P.MetaDescription,
        V.*
    From dbo.CMS_BanLanhDaoPageVersion V
    Inner Join dbo.CMS_LandingPage P On P.LandingPageID = V.LandingPageID
    Where V.BanLanhDaoPageVersionID = @BanLanhDaoPageVersionID
      And P.PageName = N'BAN_LANH_DAO'
END
GO

IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.CMS_BanLanhDaoPage_VersionListCMS', N'P') IS NOT NULL
    DROP PROCEDURE dbo.CMS_BanLanhDaoPage_VersionListCMS
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.CMS_BanLanhDaoPage_VersionListCMS
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON

    Select Top 50
        V.BanLanhDaoPageVersionID,
        V.VersionNo,
        V.IsPublished,
        V.CreatedDate,
        V.CreatedUser,
        V.PublishedDate,
        V.PublishedUser
    From dbo.CMS_BanLanhDaoPageVersion V
    Inner Join dbo.CMS_LandingPage P On P.LandingPageID = V.LandingPageID
    Where P.PageName = N'BAN_LANH_DAO'
    Order By V.BanLanhDaoPageVersionID Desc
END
GO

IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.CMS_BanLanhDaoPage_SaveCMS', N'P') IS NOT NULL
    DROP PROCEDURE dbo.CMS_BanLanhDaoPage_SaveCMS
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.CMS_BanLanhDaoPage_SaveCMS
    @Title NVARCHAR(500),
    @Slug NVARCHAR(200),
    @MetaDescription NVARCHAR(1000) = NULL,
    @HtmlBodyVi NVARCHAR(MAX),
    @HtmlBodyEn NVARCHAR(MAX) = NULL,
    @CssText NVARCHAR(MAX) = NULL,
    @ProjectJsonVi NVARCHAR(MAX) = NULL,
    @ProjectJsonEn NVARCHAR(MAX) = NULL,
    @Publish BIT = 0,
    @UserName NVARCHAR(100) = NULL
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON
    SET XACT_ABORT ON

    BEGIN TRANSACTION

    DECLARE @LandingPageID INT
    DECLARE @VersionNo INT
    DECLARE @VersionID BIGINT

    Select Top 1 @LandingPageID = LandingPageID
    From dbo.CMS_LandingPage With (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK)
    Where PageName = N'BAN_LANH_DAO'
    Order By LandingPageID

    IF @LandingPageID IS NULL
    BEGIN
        Insert Into dbo.CMS_LandingPage
        (
            Slug, Title, Description, Keyword, CssText, HtmlBody,
            IsActive, SortOrder, CreatedDate, CreatedUser,
            ProjectJson, PageName, MetaDescription
        )
        Values
        (
            @Slug, @Title, N'Ban Lanh Dao system page', N'ban-lanh-dao', NULL, NULL,
            0, 0, GETDATE(), @UserName, NULL, N'BAN_LANH_DAO', @MetaDescription
        )
        SET @LandingPageID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    END

    Update dbo.CMS_LandingPage
    Set Slug = @Slug,
        Title = @Title,
        MetaDescription = @MetaDescription,
        UpdatedDate = GETDATE(),
        UpdatedUser = @UserName
    Where LandingPageID = @LandingPageID

    Select @VersionNo = ISNULL(MAX(VersionNo), 0) + 1
    From dbo.CMS_BanLanhDaoPageVersion With (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK)
    Where LandingPageID = @LandingPageID

    IF @Publish = 1
        Update dbo.CMS_BanLanhDaoPageVersion
        Set IsPublished = 0
        Where LandingPageID = @LandingPageID And IsPublished = 1

    Insert Into dbo.CMS_BanLanhDaoPageVersion
    (
        LandingPageID, VersionNo, HtmlBodyVi, HtmlBodyEn, CssText,
        ProjectJsonVi, ProjectJsonEn, IsPublished, CreatedDate, CreatedUser,
        PublishedDate, PublishedUser
    )
    Values
    (
        @LandingPageID, @VersionNo, @HtmlBodyVi, @HtmlBodyEn, @CssText,
        @ProjectJsonVi, @ProjectJsonEn, @Publish, GETDATE(), @UserName,
        Case When @Publish = 1 Then GETDATE() Else NULL End,
        Case When @Publish = 1 Then @UserName Else NULL End
    )

    SET @VersionID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

    IF @Publish = 1
    BEGIN
        Update dbo.CMS_LandingPage
        Set HtmlBody = @HtmlBodyVi,
            CssText = @CssText,
            ProjectJson = @ProjectJsonVi,
            IsActive = 1,
            UpdatedDate = GETDATE(),
            UpdatedUser = @UserName
        Where LandingPageID = @LandingPageID
    END

    COMMIT TRANSACTION

    Select @LandingPageID As LandingPageID,
           @VersionID As BanLanhDaoPageVersionID,
           @VersionNo As VersionNo,
           @Publish As IsPublished
END
GO

IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.CMS_BanLanhDaoPage_RestoreCMS', N'P') IS NOT NULL
    DROP PROCEDURE dbo.CMS_BanLanhDaoPage_RestoreCMS
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.CMS_BanLanhDaoPage_RestoreCMS
    @BanLanhDaoPageVersionID BIGINT,
    @UserName NVARCHAR(100) = NULL
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON

    DECLARE @Title NVARCHAR(500)
    DECLARE @Slug NVARCHAR(200)
    DECLARE @MetaDescription NVARCHAR(1000)
    DECLARE @HtmlBodyVi NVARCHAR(MAX)
    DECLARE @HtmlBodyEn NVARCHAR(MAX)
    DECLARE @CssText NVARCHAR(MAX)
    DECLARE @ProjectJsonVi NVARCHAR(MAX)
    DECLARE @ProjectJsonEn NVARCHAR(MAX)

    Select
        @Title = P.Title,
        @Slug = P.Slug,
        @MetaDescription = P.MetaDescription,
        @HtmlBodyVi = V.HtmlBodyVi,
        @HtmlBodyEn = V.HtmlBodyEn,
        @CssText = V.CssText,
        @ProjectJsonVi = V.ProjectJsonVi,
        @ProjectJsonEn = V.ProjectJsonEn
    From dbo.CMS_BanLanhDaoPageVersion V
    Inner Join dbo.CMS_LandingPage P On P.LandingPageID = V.LandingPageID
    Where V.BanLanhDaoPageVersionID = @BanLanhDaoPageVersionID
      And P.PageName = N'BAN_LANH_DAO'

    IF @HtmlBodyVi IS NULL
    BEGIN
        RAISERROR(N'Khong tim thay version Ban Lanh Dao.', 16, 1)
        RETURN
    END

    EXEC dbo.CMS_BanLanhDaoPage_SaveCMS
        @Title = @Title,
        @Slug = @Slug,
        @MetaDescription = @MetaDescription,
        @HtmlBodyVi = @HtmlBodyVi,
        @HtmlBodyEn = @HtmlBodyEn,
        @CssText = @CssText,
        @ProjectJsonVi = @ProjectJsonVi,
        @ProjectJsonEn = @ProjectJsonEn,
        @Publish = 1,
        @UserName = @UserName
END
GO

Đã tạo module **Ban Lãnh Đạo** theo mô hình TiemChung/About Full Page CMS. Tóm tắt:

## Cơ chế trang động

- Trang đọc nội dung từ `CMS_BanLanhDaoPage_GetPublished` (HTML + CSS + ProjectJson).
- Nếu chưa chạy SQL hoặc chưa publish → hiển thị **fallback markup** trong `.ascx`.
- Hỗ trợ `?cmsTemplate=1&languageId=1|2` cho preview CMS.

## Cấu trúc đã tạo

**HOS**
- `HOS/Controls/Information/BanLanhDao/SectionBanLanhDao.ascx` (+ `.cs`, `.css.inc`, `.js`)
- `HOS/Pages/Information/BanLanhDao/SectionBanLanhDao.aspx` (+ code-behind)
- `HOS/Media/BanLanhDao/` — ảnh tại `/Media/BanLanhDao/...`

SET NOCOUNT ON

IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.CMS_BanLanhDaoPageVersion', N'U') IS NULL

DECLARE @Title NVARCHAR(500)
DECLARE @Slug NVARCHAR(200)
DECLARE @MetaDescription NVARCHAR(1000)
DECLARE @HtmlBodyVi NVARCHAR(MAX)
DECLARE @HtmlBodyEn NVARCHAR(MAX)
DECLARE @CssText NVARCHAR(MAX)
DECLARE @ProjectJsonVi NVARCHAR(MAX)
DECLARE @ProjectJsonEn NVARCHAR(MAX)
DECLARE @Dirty BIT = 0

Select Top 1
    @Title = P.Title,
    @Slug = P.Slug,
    @MetaDescription = P.MetaDescription,
    @HtmlBodyVi = V.HtmlBodyVi,
    @HtmlBodyEn = IsNull(V.HtmlBodyEn, V.HtmlBodyVi),
    @CssText = V.CssText,
    @ProjectJsonVi = V.ProjectJsonVi,
    @ProjectJsonEn = V.ProjectJsonEn
From dbo.CMS_BanLanhDaoPageVersion V
Inner Join dbo.CMS_LandingPage P
    On P.LandingPageID = V.LandingPageID
Where V.IsPublished = 1
  And P.PageName = N'BAN_LANH_DAO'
Order By V.VersionNo Desc

IF @HtmlBodyVi IS NULL
BEGIN
    RAISERROR(N'Khong tim thay version dang xuat ban.', 16, 1)
    RETURN
END

IF @HtmlBodyVi LIKE '%HasFullPage%' OR @HtmlBodyVi LIKE '%FullPageHtml%' OR @HtmlBodyVi LIKE '%<%'
BEGIN
    SET @HtmlBodyVi = Replace(@HtmlBodyVi, N'<% if (HasFullPage) { %>', N'')
    SET @HtmlBodyVi = Replace(@HtmlBodyVi, N'<%= FullPageHtml %>', N'')
    SET @HtmlBodyVi = Replace(@HtmlBodyVi, N'<% } else { %>', N'')
    SET @HtmlBodyVi = Replace(@HtmlBodyVi, N'<% } %>', N'')
    SET @Dirty = 1
END
